source: F18-SC-006 benchmark measurement, Stack A local reset on 2026-11-16
headroom_rule: For measured byte/count/latency maxima, record ceil(maximum observed across baseline runs × 1.25), capped at any applicable specification target. F18-SC-006 caps publish latency at 300 ms; the measured 262.824 ms maximum leaves 37.176 ms (about 12% of the ceiling) of margin. The 143 ms read ceiling remains below the 300 ms SC target. Entries without a specification target retain 25% headroom. Decimal places remain capped by the document contract at 3, without headroom. This is a measured operating envelope, not a new product-side validator limit.
